newsitem.title: USA: Apple could sell key business units - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Apple could sell key business units - WSJ.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc is considering selling key business units to step up its cost-cutting efforts, the Wall Street Journal said Monday.
The paper said people inside the company believe the units include Apple's Newton hand-held computer unit, which could be sold to venture capitalists, and some of its software development operations.

The report said the moves are forced by slower-than-expected sales of Apple's Macintosh computers, adding that the U.S.'s fourth-largest maker of personal computers is expecting revenues to fall 20 percent to $8 billion in its current fiscal year.
On Sunday a person close to Apple told Reuters that the company plans to cut its operations to three groups and announce on Monday a round of massive job cuts.
